At the start of each Conquest match players will get to select an Aspect and a Relic
The order of the selections are
Auto Build
Relic
Aspect
Aspects and Relics can be changed after selection by using the “undo” button in the item shop and then buying a new one. Aspects and Relics cannot be sold and changed after leaving base with one.
Match History tab has been added to the front-end.
Code Redemption has been added to the front-end.
Item Purchase notifications have been added in-game.
VGS keys are now rebindable.
New Map Features
Stealth zones added in the center area of Arena
Jungle buffs are updated to match the new buffs dropped in Conquest
Their infamy levels are automatically set to 3 and will not change throughout the match
New Relic: Battle Cry
Replaces the Ward utility relic
Gains 1 charge whenever you defeat a player or when you are defeated
Activate the relic to gain +10 Strength, Intelligence, and Health Regen per charge
Max 5 charges
New Killstreak Effect: Hot Streak
Players gain ‘Hot Streak’ if they are on a killstreak
A killstreak is 3 player kills in one life
While on a ‘Hot Streak,’ that player will deal, and take, 20% more damage
The player who defeats someone who is on a Hot Streak gains +100 bonus gold per difference in level (on top of the original killstreak ender gold)
For example, if a player A is level 10 and player B is level 8, player B would get +200g on top of the original killstreak ender bonus
New Environmental Pickups: Crowd Gifts
Every 90 seconds, the crowd will throw a gift into the middle of Arena
Every time a gift is thrown, the overall spawn timer is reduced by 5 seconds
For example, when the crowd throws its first gift in the match, the next spawn timer is set to 85 seconds
Every time a player is killed, the current timer is reduced by 10 seconds
For example, if an 85 seconds gift spawn timer was active and 45 seconds of it were left, a player kill would reduce that timer by 10 seconds. The overall timer is unaffected.
Picking up this gift grants +15 Strength, Intelligence, and 1% Max Health Regen
Lasts for 30 seconds
The gift increases its reward by +10 for every 3 minutes that have passed in the match
New Phase Effects: Ten Ticket Phase
When a team is 10 tickets away from winning, two things will happen:
The crowd starts cheering for the finale! From this point on, in addition to the gifts being thrown in the center, the crowd will throw gifts at this team!
Happens at a random time every 15-20 seconds
The brutes on the opposing team get fired up! They will deal +40% more damage and receive 40% less damage
All Jungle Buffs
Fixed jungle buff values stacking if you had a higher level buff and picked up a lower level buff
Yellow Buff Nerf
Pathfinder I - Reduced ability protection shred from 10 to 5
Pathfinder III - Reduced ability protection shred from 20 to 10
Select “Enter Practice” while viewing a god's abilities or from the “Change Game Mode” button on the home screen.
This map now has an entirely new environment
By default, there is a god bot with a DPS tracker, a Jungle Camp, and Conquest Jungle Buffs to pick up.
The mode now has a UI-based system for accessing a variety of practice tools.
Press TAB (or the corresponding scoreboard button on consoles) to access
Reset Health and Mana
Reset Cooldowns
Toggle Damage Immunity
Toggle Reduced Cooldowns
Toggle Infinite Mana
Add Gold
Add Levels
Set level 20
Set level 1
Spawn God Bots
Spawn a new God Bot - spawns in with a new DPS tracker
Apply Settings to Bot - copies settings from the above section to this initially spawned bot
Toggle Give Inventory - toggle this on to spawn a bot that will equip the same items you currently have equipped
Toggle Team - toggle to spawn allied or enemy bots - applies on next spawn
Add/Subtract Level - adjust the level you want bots to spawn in - applies on next spawn

content.text: “Both the Gods and Item balance of this update focus on buffing many of the underperforming Tanky gods and items, and nerfing the top performing DPS Gods and Items.”
